actor.name: Multinational Joint Task Force (Lake Chad)
actor.seat: N'Djamena (headquarters not verified in sources found)

relations_to.summary: Hold the Lake Chad front through the MNJTF with Cameroon and Nigeria, mandated against Boko Haram and ISWAP. The June 2026 preview says Chad has threatened to reduce or pull out; the membership objective is what the threat puts in question.

sources.title: June 2026 Monthly Forecast: UNOCA and Central Africa
